newsitem.title: USA: Shoney's urged to consider new leadership.
newsitem.headline: Shoney's urged to consider new leadership.

text.p: The shareholders' committee of restaurant operator Shoney's Inc said on Monday that an advisory organization had recommended that the company's shareholders consider replacing the company's current board of directors with the committee's slate of nominees.

The recommendation, made by Institutional Shareholders Services, urged the committee to demand a special meeting to consider the slate proposal, "in view of Shoney's long-term lackluster performance," the shareholder committee said in a statement.
To that end, the ISS encouraged shareholders to send in their Blue Agent Designation cards to the Shoney's shareholders' committee.
The committee needs to obtain the cards from shareholders representing at least 10 percent of Shoney's outstanding shares to call a special meeting.
